# Likhon Sarker (Main Uddin Sarker)

> Full-stack software engineer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Also known online as iamlikhon / "I am Likhon". Works across full-stack, backend, frontend, and AI engineering.

Likhon Sarker is a full-stack software engineer in Dhaka, Bangladesh, working with Go (Golang), JavaScript, TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, and gRPC — plus AI-powered tooling (Gemini, FastAPI-based AI services). He ships backend systems and the frontend products that sit on top of them, and runs the infrastructure (Docker, Caddy, CI/CD) that keeps them live in production.
